notifications.name: Power 12 Inch Mini Battery Electric Chainsaw
notifications.danger: Due to poor quality of the internal soldering and the inadequate creepage and clearance distances within the charger, the user could have access to live parts and receive an electric shock. Moreover, as the product lacks a manually activated chain brake, if the product kicks back’ during use, the user may lose control of the chainsaw, and be injured. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Machinery Directive.

notifications.name: Sushi party
notifications.danger: The surface of the lid underneath the handle of the appliance reaches too high temperatures. The user may inadvertently touch this surface during use, resulting in burns. Additionally, the creepage distances for the main insulation are insufficient. This may lead to the user receiving an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standards EN 60335-1 and EN 60335-2-15.

notifications.danger: The cable is not properly anchored (missing cable strain relief) and the accessible wires have inadequate insulation. notifications.name: Children’s Busy Board
notifications.danger: The product has small pieces that can easily detach (the keys). A small child may put it in the mouth and choke. Moreover, the steering wheel and light battery compartment can be easily opened, leaving the button batteries accessible. A child may put them in the mouth and swallow them, which could cause damage to the child’s gastrointestinal tract and/or choking. Additionally, the rope at the top and cord used to secure the phone toy to the board is too long and could tangle around the child's neck causing strangulation. This product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive.
